It can be accessed from the {{Zone|Spring Path}}. {{ZoneText|Go fishing for &6Torrhus Sea Creatures&f.|Dive down into &bTorrhus Springs&f.|Hunt &fmobs that live in and around the &bSprings&f!}} == Features == The '''Torrhus Springs''' contains a tall body of water that players can swim down. The top of it is the {{Zone|Spring Shallows}}, and lower down, players reach the {{Zone|Spring Depths}}, which connects to the {{Zone|Ant's Cave}}, {{Zone|Hotspot Haven}}, and {{Zone|Desert Temple}}. Players can also fish from the water to catch [[Sea Creatures]], such as the {{MobSprite|Haggard}}, {{MobSprite|Brineling}}, {{MobSprite|Sprawl}}, {{MobSprite|Torrid}}, {{MobSprite|Silkbreeze}}, and {{MobSprite|Giant Isopod}}. == Zones == {| class="wikitable" !
